images.prompt: Close view of the back of a dark server rack in a data centre, a single black security monitoring unit mounted in it with dozens of network cables plugged into it and fanning out in every direction, small green status lights, cold blue ambient light, deep shadows.

A heavy ring of old brass keys hanging from a hook on a wall at the end of a long dark office corridor lined with closed doors, warm light from a single ceiling lamp falling on the keys, the corridor fading into darkness behind.
A plain round office wall clock without numbers on a dark wall above a row of empty desks in a quiet office at night, faint cold light from a window, dust in the air, still and silent.

Close view of a large monitor in a dark operations room showing two long columns of blurred figures side by side, one row between them glowing red, an operator seen from behind as a dark silhouette leaning toward the screen, red light on the shoulders.
A bank counter at night with its metal roller shutter pulled down and locked, a small queue barrier rope in front of it, a single ceiling light above, an empty marble floor, cold and deserted.

Close view of an industrial control panel in a dim room with a row of large switches, one switch pulled down with a red tag hanging from it, the other switches still up, warm light from the side, a cable running out of frame.
A tall heap of shredded paper strips spilling out of an office shredder bin onto a dark floor, a single strip lying apart in a beam of cold light from a window, dust floating in the light.
A large cargo ship loaded with containers leaving a harbour at dawn, seen from the dock, calm grey water, the sky turning pale orange behind, cranes in silhouette, mist over the water.
An empty container harbour at night, a single long wake on the dark water leading out to sea, harbour lights reflected as long streaks, cranes standing still in silhouette, thin fog.

Close view of a heavy steel door with a brand new keypad lock and a second key lock fitted beside it, fresh screws and metal shavings on a cloth on the floor below, a work lamp lighting the door, dark corridor around.

Looking out through a large office window at an Asian metropolis at half past two in the morning, a sea of dim city lights below, a single small notification glow reflected faintly in the glass, the dark office edge in the foreground.
A security guard's peaked cap and a radio left on an empty reception desk in a dark lobby, the chair pushed back, a bank of small monitors glowing faintly behind, warm light from one desk lamp.

A single server in a dark empty room with all its status lights blinking steadily, a red alarm light glowing on the wall far behind it, the server sitting alone on a raised floor, cold blue light and red reflections.
